Clerk of Courts

Kenneth Louis

The Newark Municipal Court tries to give all court users a fair and systematic decision in cases in the municipal Court. The Court also gives high-quality and well-organized customer services to the public. This Court is an independent government branch, protecting the right warranted by the United States of Law. Newark Municipal Court sessions grasp their session five days in the morning and afternoon. Virtual Court Session is also available in this Court.

Court Division

Newark Municipal Court Division consists of three divisions that are:

  • Criminal Division
  • Violation Bureau Division
  • Customer Service Division

Criminal Division

Newark Municipal Court Criminal Division is located in Customer Service Window room no. 207 five days a week from 8:30 am to 3:45 pm. In this division, the staff will accept citizen issues of filing, answer people's random questions and build expected sources determination on complaints. 

see also Circuit Court">Oldham County Circuit Court

Violation Bureau

Newark Municipal Court Violation Bureau is the division for violation cases. The violation Bureau Bail Posting and Payment Window is open six days a week, and its payment can be made in person or online using http://www.njmcdirect.com.

Customer Service

Newark Municipal Court Customer Service is a division that contains the Call Center for Court, Unit of Correspondence, and Customer Service Room 105. The Call Center phones will give information to people in 200 languages, and they can pick up 1000 calls daily. The Unit of Correspondence will watch and track thousands of resemblances each Month. The Customer Service Room 105 will plan CourtCourt when required and answer the random question of people.

How to Case Lookup

Newark Municipal Court Case Lookup can be done in the following ways:

  • Searching by Name
  • Searching by Case Number
  • Searching by Phone Number
  • Searching by Email
  • Searching by Address

How to do Case Search

Newark Municipal Court Case Search can be done if you type First and Last Name with the State Name. This way, you can search any case and get all the information about the case.

How to do a Fine Payment?

Newark Municipal Court payment can be made in three ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the CourtCourt during business hours with the necessary documents.

Online

A person can make payments online by using any online payment system. The CourtCourt accepts all online payment methods.

Pay by Mail

A person can send a check to the mailing address of Newark County Municipal Court. The mailing address is 31 Green Street, Newark, NJ 07102.

Can I have a Virtual Hearing?

Newark Municipal Court Virtual Hearing is introduced due to COVID 19. All court session hearings are done via zoom. A person must fill out a form for a court date request via zoom. After reviewing the request, the CourtCourt will give a schedule via email or phone for your case in a virtual hearing.

see also The Supreme Court Do">What Does The Supreme Court Do?

how to do Online Case Resolution?

Newark Municipal Court Online Case Resolution is a new method that allows case resolution using mail without any zoom meeting. Check your ticket and enter the information of the ticket; for reviewing the process, select Dispute case. That will connect you with the prosecutor, and your case can be resolved.

Newark Municipal Court Wedding:

Newark Municipal Court Wedding fees are $28. If you want to get the marriage license from Newark Court, then you must fulfill all the requirements needed by the CourtCourt and submit an application form. The Court gives the wedding schedule after you submit an application form. Requirement and Application Forms are available in English as well as in Spanish.

Newark Municipal Court Public Defender:

Newark Municipal Court Public Defender Office constitutes destitute individuals charged in the Court of Municipal with the offenses that, if convicted, there is a chance of different consequences of magnitude. Client Profile Application and Appeal Notification Form are available in Public Defender Newest Municipal Court.

FAQ

How many courtrooms does Newark Municipal Court have?

Newark Municipal Court has six courtrooms. These are Courtroom 101,103,108,202,222 and A301.

Does Newark Municipal Court resolve domestic violence?

Yes, Courtroom A301 criminal court hears and resolves all domestic violence cases every Tuesday and Thursday.

What is the location of the Newest Court Marriage Bureau Office?

Newest Court Marriage Bureau Office is located at 920 Broad St – Room B-9

Newark, NJ 07102.

What is the complaint number of the Newest Municipal Court?

Newest Municipal Court Complaint Number is 973-733-6520.

How many Forms are available in the Newest Municipal Court?

Newest Municipal Court forms consist of 6 forms. These are the Workflow Form, Public Defender Application Form, Plea by Mail Form, Offenses Eligible for a Dispute Case, Expungement Order Form, and Record Request Order Form.

How can I pay for a Parking Ticket sent by Newest Municipal Court?

Newest Municipal Court Parking Ticket can be paid online, by mail, or In-Person. If you want to pay online, it must be done using any online payment system; if you want to pay it by going to Court, visit the CourtCourt during business hours.

How can I know my Zoom Meeting ID?

Newest Municipal Court Zoom Meeting ID can be known by seeing the list on the website. You will receive a date and schedule, and according to that schedule, you can see your meeting I from the list.

How can I find out how much I owe in tax?

You can find your tax amount by calling Customer Service during Business Hours. They give you all the information.
